title: Crypto Release Radar configuration
description: Local explicit repository configuration. Run --validate-config for authoritative validation, including case-insensitive slug uniqueness. Associate this schema externally; $schema is not a config field.

groups.description: Optional independent lists. Selected-group overlap and combined budget are checked by the scan CLI, not this config schema or --validate-config.

slug.description: Explicit owner/repo slug; no URLs, credentials, control characters, or repository names '.' and '..'.

repositoryList.description: Runtime also rejects equal slugs across strings and objects, different policies, or letter casing. JSON Schema uniqueItems compares whole entries only.
